verdict.rationale: Braintrust supports several background automations: online scoring auto-evaluates production traces asynchronously as they log, CI/CD evals run automatically on PRs, and 'Patterns' runs Loop on a schedule against the trace backlog to surface recurring issues autonomously. These are genuine autonomous background processes, but evidence is entirely vendor docs with no independent confirmation of reliability or scheduling flexibility, and no user-configurable general 'automation builder' is described.
